one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never read the task spec carefully enough to discover the required output path (/app/solution.txt) or the correct objective with L2 regularization, so all 14 optimization attempts wrote to optimal_allocation.npy with the wrong cost function, leaving the evaluation harness unable to find or validate the solution.
t_err_evidence: Step 5 creates optimize.py with an objective missing the L2 regularization term and saves the result to 'optimal_allocation.npy' instead of the required '/app/solution.txt'; both decisive errors are encoded here before any solver is run.
t_commit_evidence: At step 5 the wrong objective and wrong output path are baked into the first solver script and the same two errors persist without correction across all 13 subsequent steps, locking in the failing outcome from this point.
trigger_explanation: The agent moved directly from data inspection to writing a solver without checking the task specification for the required output artifact path or the full objective formula. It assumed the objective from the natural-language description (quartic + quadratic + coupling) without discovering the L2 regularization term, and assumed a .npy output rather than looking for an explicit output-file requirement.
